description: Deterministic-shape, CSPRNG-fairness, and input-bound behavior evidence for the bundled draw.py random-draw script. These validate that the draw uses secrets (not random), stays offline, stamps rng='secrets', carries a not-serious disclaimer, and rejects illegal option lists / out-of-range draw counts. Release-gate shape: top-level scripts[] keyed by path, each case tagged kind=positive|boundary|failure; case assertions run against stdout only (draw.py writes error JSON to stderr on rejection, so stdout is empty on failure cases).

cases.name: positive_single_draw
cases.description: Default single draw over 3 distinct options returns a valid CSPRNG result of length 1, stamped rng='secrets', with a disclaimer.

cases.name: positive_multi_draw
cases.description: Multi-draw (n=5) over 3 distinct options returns 5 picks and per-option counts, stamped rng='secrets'.

cases.name: boundary_max_draws
cases.description: n=100 (upper bound) succeeds and returns 100 picks from the CSPRNG, stamped rng='secrets'.

cases.name: boundary_two_options
cases.description: Exactly 2 options (lower bound, coin-like) succeeds and returns a pick, stamped rng='secrets'.

cases.name: failure_single_option
cases.description: A single option is below the >=2 lower bound and must be rejected with a nonzero exit code (NN4). Error JSON goes to stderr; stdout is empty, so it must not contain the secrets stamp.

cases.name: failure_duplicate_options
cases.description: Duplicate options must be rejected (NN4 requires all options distinct). Error JSON goes to stderr; stdout is empty.

cases.name: failure_empty_option
cases.description: An option list that collapses to a single non-empty option after dropping empty fragments (trailing/duplicate delimiters) must be rejected (NN4 needs >=2 non-empty options). Error JSON goes to stderr; stdout is empty.

cases.name: failure_zero_draws
cases.description: n=0 is below the lower bound and must be rejected with a nonzero exit code (NN4). Error JSON goes to stderr; stdout is empty.

cases.name: failure_over_max_draws
cases.description: n=101 is above the upper bound and must be rejected with a nonzero exit code (NN4). Error JSON goes to stderr; stdout is empty.
